Megan: Quick check-in: benchmarks hub launch next Tue. Need final keyword set, schema snippets, redirect map, and an internal linking plan.
Alex: Uploaded keywords -> 'LLM inference cost', 'low-latency LLM serving', 'inference batching'. Sheet link in thread.
Priya: I'll cluster keywords into pillar + subtopics and draft meta titles.
Tom: Schema plan: Article + FAQ on hub landing, Event (webinar) with potentialAction, DataDownload for CSVs, and SoftwareApplication for demo widget.
Megan: Can you paste a short JSON-LD FAQ sample?
Tom: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"How is LLM inference cost measured?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"We calculate cost per 1M tokens using throughput and GPU-hour pricing across configs."}}]}
```
Alex: Redirects: consolidating ~12 legacy posts. Simple CSV below. SEOBot validated.
Alex: `#/old,new,reason
/blog/llm-cost-v1,/benchmarks/llm-inference-cost,consolidate
/blog/kv-cache-guide,/benchmarks/kv-cache,merge
/blog/old-embed-guide,/benchmarks/embeddings,consolidate
/blog/low-latency-tips,/benchmarks/latency,merge
/blog/quantization-explained,/benchmarks/quantization,canonicalize
/blog/onnx-optimizations,/benchmarks/onnx,redirect
/blog/legacy-benchmark-2019,/benchmarks/archive,archive-redirect

/blog/deprecated-qa,/benchmarks/faq,redirect`
SEOBot: Redirects validated: 10 entries, no cycles. Remember to preserve UTM params.
Megan: Eng asks: (1) implement 301s preserving query strings, (2) add response header `x-redirect-source` with original path for analytics.
Alex: I'll create a Jira ticket and tag infra.
Priya: Internal linking plan: hub landing -> each benchmark page -> webinar landing -> docs. Add CTAs for CSV download and webinar sign-up. Also add rel=canonical on merged pages.
Tom: Monitoring: GA4 event 'redirect_hit' + forward `x-redirect-source` to Logstash. Also test structured data in staging.
Megan: Publish checklist: meta titles, canonical tags, structured data validated, redirects in staging, sitemap update, Screaming Frog smoke test.
Priya: I'll finalize meta titles and hero copy by EOD.
Megan: Timeline: staging deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT, review 13:00 PT, prod Wed 02:00 PT. Any blockers?
Tom: Please compress hero images; Lighthouse flagging them.
Alex: Noted. I'll include hreflang notes for later locales.
SEOBot: Run Google Rich Results test after prod: https://search.google.com/test/rich-results
Megan: Thanks team, closing thread. :tada:
